svg.title: ULTRA OS module overview (16:9)
svg.desc: ULTRA OS: UltraCanvas (GUI, rendering and user interaction) on top, connected to the Media and content modules (FileLoader, PixelFX, AudioFX, VideoFX), with the Intelligence modules (UltraAI, SmartHome) and the Connectivity and devices modules (UltraNet, IODeviceManager) below.
